Subject: Intro + demo times (SGT / JST / AEDT)

Hi Connor —

Thanks for offering time for a live demo. We have two groups at Acme that want to join (SG office + Sydney operations). Proposed windows that work for both:

- Option A: Tue Oct 21, 10:00 JST / 09:00 SGT / 11:00 AEDT — morning for JP/SG, late morning for SYD
- Option B: Tue Oct 21, 23:30 SGT / 00:30 JST (next day) / 00:30 AEDT (next day) — late slot that only the APAC night-shift can join

Option A is preferred but we wanted to offer the late slot in case your engineers are only available after US hours.

Attached a short agenda and our team list. If you create a calendar invite please flag which timezone you're using — last time we had a flip where Sydney saw the meeting as the following day.

Thanks,

Luke — thanks for the options and for flagging the previous calendar mismatch. Looping in Laura (who handles scheduling for APAC demos).

A couple quick points so we don't end up with the next-day surprise:
- For Option A please confirm you mean local morning on Oct 21 everywhere (i.e. 09:00 SGT / 10:00 JST / 11:00 AEDT). That maps to the same absolute time across zones.
- Option B (23:30 SGT) will indeed show as 00:30 the following calendar day in Sydney and Tokyo — that's the root of the "next-day" confusion. We generally avoid anything that crosses local midnight for attendees in different daylight-savings rules.

If Option A works we'll send a single invite and force the TZ in the .ics to Asia/Singapore and include explicit local time descriptions in the invite text. Laura: can you watch for any DST/TZ quirks in the invite?

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com
